description: This is a C source file implementing the main platform management logic for a device, including system event handling, network interface configuration, and process management.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes the platform management system, daemonizes if on Linux, and enters an infinite loop.

methods.name: Platform_Manager_Init
methods.description: Initializes system configuration, sysevent, network interfaces, and sets initial device mode.

methods.name: checkIfUtopiaIsInstalled
methods.description: Checks if the Utopia system is initialized by verifying the existence of a specific file.

methods.name: IsEthWanEnabled
methods.description: Checks if Ethernet WAN is enabled based on system configuration.

methods.name: Get_PmThreadType
methods.description: Maps a string name to a specific thread event type.

methods.name: PMEthWan_SysCfgGetInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value from system configuration.

methods.name: PMETHWAN_SysCfgSetInt
methods.description: Sets an integer value in system configuration.

methods.name: validate_mode
methods.description: Validates and corrects the device's bridge mode setting.

methods.name: getSyseventBridgeMode
methods.description: Determines the device's bridge mode based on erouter and bridge mode settings.

methods.name: PMEthWan_EnterBridgeMode
methods.description: Configures the device to operate in bridge mode.

methods.name: PMEthWan_EnterRouterMode
methods.description: Configures the device to operate in router mode.

methods.name: UpdateActiveDeviceMode
methods.description: Updates the active device mode based on current configuration.

methods.name: PMEthWan_ProcessUtopiaRestart
methods.description: Handles system restart events, updating routing/bridging state accordingly.

methods.name: IsFileExists
methods.description: Checks if a specified file exists.

methods.name: PM_Util_get_shell_output
methods.description: Executes a shell command and captures its output.

methods.name: findProcessId
methods.description: Finds the process ID of a given process name.

methods.name: daemonize
methods.description: Turns the process into a daemon on Linux systems.
